title: Hyderabad Police arrest four for using aluminium foil disguised as silver foil in sweets, paan and bakery products

ai.summary: Hyderabad police arrested four individuals for manufacturing and selling counterfeit aluminium foil disguised as edible silver waraq, posing health risks to consumers.

facts.claim: Hyderabad police arrested four individuals for manufacturing and selling counterfeit aluminium foil disguised as edible silver waraq
facts.quote: The Hyderabad City Police have busted four illegal manufacturing units involved in producing and supplying aluminium foil and flakes disguised as edible silver waraq, arresting four persons and seizing large quantities of counterfeit material, adulterants and manufacturing equipment, posing a potential health risk to consumers.

facts.claim: The counterfeit material poses health risks
facts.quote: Consumption of non-food-grade aluminium products over a prolonged period could lead to kidney damage, neurological effects, bone disorders and digestive irritation, besides excessive accumulation of aluminium in the body.
